name: camper-rally-map
description: Search current one-way campervan relocation deals in Europe from Roadsurfer, IndyCampers and Imoova by city, dates and provider, with booking links.

interface.longDescription:
Camper Rally Map collects one-way campervan relocation deals in Europe from three rental companies: Roadsurfer, IndyCampers and Imoova. A relocation deal is a campervan that a rental company needs moved from one city to another within a set window of dates.

This server lets an assistant search those deals. You can ask for deals from a city, to a city, between two cities, in a date range or from one provider. A city matches every pickup or drop-off city within 60 km. You can also ask which cities have deals right now.

Every deal comes with the provider's own booking link and a link that opens the deal's pickup city on the Camper Rally Map. Booking happens on the provider's site.

The server is read-only and needs no account, sign-in or API key. It cannot book, pay or change anything. Deals are synced from the providers four times a day, so a deal can be gone by the time you open its link.
capabilities: Search relocation deals by pickup city, drop-off city, dates and provider
List the cities that currently have deals
Provider booking link and map link on every deal
defaultPrompt: Find one-way campervan relocation deals from Munich in the next six weeks.
Which cities have campervan relocation deals right now?
Show Roadsurfer relocation deals from Munich next month, with booking links.

positive.description: List the cities that have deals
positive.prompt: Which cities have campervan relocation deals right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_cities with no filters and answers with cities that currently have relocation deals. The data is live, so the cities and counts vary.

positive.description: Search from a city in a date window
positive.prompt: Find one-way campervan relocation deals from Munich in the next six weeks.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_deals with from Munich and a start_date and end_date covering the next six weeks. Lists the matching deals with provider, drop-off city, dates and booking link. If no deal matches, says so plainly and may offer a wider search.

positive.prompt: Show only Roadsurfer relocation deals from Berlin next month, with booking links.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_deals with from Berlin, providers set to roadsurfer and next month's dates. Shows only Roadsurfer deals, each with its booking link, or says that none match.

positive.prompt: Compare relocation deals into Berlin from any city over the next month.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_deals with to Berlin and next month's dates, without a pickup city. Compares the deals by pickup city, dates and provider, or says that none match.

positive.description: Find the nearest city with deals
positive.prompt: I want to pick up a relocation campervan near Utrecht. What is close by?
positive.expected_behavior: Uses list_cities to find cities with deals near Utrecht, then search_deals from one of them. Names the nearby cities and shows deals with booking links, or says that nothing is nearby right now.

negative.description: Weather question, not about relocation deals
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Barcelona this weekend?
Find me a cheap flight from Amsterdam to Barcelona.

negative.description: General campervan advice needs no deal lookup
negative.prompt: Write a packing list for a week in a campervan.

publication.release_notes: First release. Two read-only tools: search_deals finds one-way campervan relocation deals in Europe by city, dates and provider, and list_cities lists the cities that have deals.
